description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phantasmal Image's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
Repeat from step 2.
